# [CS007] Archive Path Traversal (Zip Slip) (archive-zip-slip)

Archive entry names are used as file paths without confinement.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | CRITICAL |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-22](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html) |
| **OWASP** | A01:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Entry names in zip and tar archives are attacker-controlled and may contain ../ or absolute paths, so extracting writes outside the target directory, for example over a binary or an SSH key. Extract through os.Root, or check that the cleaned path stays inside the destination.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
for _, f := range zr.File {
	out, _ := os.Create(filepath.Join(dest, f.Name))
	rc, _ := f.Open()
	_, _ = io.Copy(out, rc)
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
root, err := os.OpenRoot(dest)
if err != nil {
	return err
}
defer root.Close()
for _, f := range zr.File {
	out, err := root.Create(f.Name) // fails for names that leave dest
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rc, _ := f.Open()
	_, err = io.Copy(out, io.LimitReader(rc, maxEntrySize))
	rc.Close()
	out.Close()
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [archive-zip-slip]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    archive-zip-slip: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore archive-zip-slip -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** archive-zip-slip
```
